summary: Validated newly added auth safeguards, CORS origin allowlist behavior, and SMS/2FA flows across backend and frontend. Existing 18-test SMS suite still passes (18/18). Added a new 9-test suite for throttling/CORS + isolated positive member/admin SMS/TOTP/email/backup flows with TEST-ONLY mocked transport and isolated DB; all 9 passed.

ui_bugs.issue: Phone setup section is collapsible but has no dedicated data-testid on the toggle button, making deterministic automation brittle.
ui_bugs.selector: button:has-text('My Sign-in Phone (Text me a code)')

integration_issues.issue: Runtime correctly returns explicit 503 when Twilio credentials are missing (expected by requirements).
Runtime correctly reaches challenge UI and SMS method, then returns explicit 503 due missing SMS provider config; backup fallback login works.

action_items: No backend functional defects found in tested scope; keep explicit SMS 503 behavior until Twilio credentials are provisioned.
Optional: add data-testid to AdminDashboard phone section toggle for stable E2E automation.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS now correctly enforces explicit origins (including preview rewritten host) and rejects untrusted preflights in tested path.
Per-account persistent throttle behavior is wired for both /api/auth/login and /api/admin/login with role isolation, Retry-After, and success reset in tested scenarios.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all requested auth/mobile/admin paths validated; AdminPhoneSetup remove-error path validated with TEST-ONLY MOCKED API response)

seed_data_creation: Created disposable runtime admin account disp_sms_admin for browser 2FA challenge testing; documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Isolated DBs for in-process tests were auto-dropped after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Real SMS delivery remains unavailable by design without Twilio credentials. Positive member/admin SMS flows were verified IN-PROCESS with MOCKED Twilio transport and isolated DB. Frontend challenge UI, mobile navbar entry, and backup fallback were verified against public URL; AdminPhoneSetup error handling also verified with TEST-ONLY MOCKED route responses.
rca of the issue: Observed 503 SMS failures are expected environmental outcomes: TWILIO credentials/sender are intentionally absent, so endpoints fail closed with sanitized explicit 503 and no usable OTP. This is not a code regression in tested scope.
